key_rationale: With headline CPI at 5.55% remaining uncomfortably close to the upper tolerance threshold and food inflation elevated at 8.70%, we must remain vigilant against the risk of inflation expectations becoming unanchored. Given the positive output gap of 0.60% and the need to ensure full monetary transmission, maintaining the current repo rate of 6.50% and the stance of withdrawal of accommodation is essential to align liquidity and anchor inflation toward the 4.00% target.
